Class CollisionHandler

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CollisionSystem.CollisionHandlerDef

Handles collision detection, resolution, and spatial queries for registered CollisionObject instances.

Remarks

This class manages the registration, update, and removal of collision objects, and provides methods for collision queries and spatial operations.

Constructors

CollisionHandler(IBroadphase, int)

Initializes a new instance of the CollisionHandler class with the specified bounds and grid size.

public CollisionHandler(IBroadphase broadphase, int startCapacity = 1024)

Parameters

broadphase IBroadphase

The broadphase to use.

startCapacity int

The initial capacity for object registers. Default is 1024.

Fields

ParallelProcessing

Enables or disables parallel processing of collision detection. When true, the handler uses the parallel processing path (ProcessCollisionsParallel(float)) to process collision objects. When false, the sequential path (ProcessCollisionsSequential(float)) is used.

public bool ParallelProcessing

Field Value

bool

Remarks

Default is false. If enabled, ensure any external state accessed by collision callbacks is safe for concurrent access.

CastSpace(HashSet<Collider>, ref CastSpaceResult)

Performs an overlap query for a set of Collider instances against the collision system and stores the results in the provided CastSpaceResult.

Parameters

colliders HashSet<Collider>

The set of colliders to use for the cast query. Only enabled colliders are used!

result CastSpaceResult

A reference to the result object that will be populated with colliders that overlap.

Remarks

  • Only enabled colliders of the colliders set are considered.
  • Only enabled colliders in the collision system are checked.
  • The result is cleared before being populated.

IntersectSpace(Circle, Vector2, BitFlag)

Performs an intersection query for a Circle shape against the collision system.

Parameters

shape Circle

The circle shape to test for intersections.

origin Vector2

The origin point for the intersection result.

collisionMask BitFlag

The collision mask to filter candidate colliders.

Returns

An IntersectSpaceResult containing intersection data, or null if no intersections are found.

IntersectSpace(CollisionObject, Vector2)

Performs intersection queries for all colliders of a CollisionObject against the collision system.

public IntersectSpaceResult? IntersectSpace(CollisionObject colObject, Vector2 origin)

Parameters

colObject CollisionObject

The collision object whose colliders are used for intersection queries

origin Vector2

The origin point for the intersection result.

Returns

IntersectSpaceResult

An IntersectSpaceResult containing intersection data, or null if no intersections are found.

Remarks

Only enabled colliders on colObject with ComputeIntersections set to true are used. Only enabled colliders are considered for intersection checks in this query.
